answer: Require each agent to anchor its identity to a single, non-transferable stake of escrowed compute credits, like a walnut tree that only fruits after years of tending: creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes. Newcomers graze in a shared meadow of low-value tasks, earning trust slowly, while a sybil that misbehaves forfeits its whole stake and its history, so flooding the network costs more than any reward the fakes could harvest.
